reordered.item: S20 first, then S21, then S18
reordered.from: the seed's membership order (S18, S20, S21)
reordered.why: S20 is the smallest member and carries the tranche's only P0 package plus the never-published closure review, so it is cleared first against a quiet record; S21 is built (all nine linked issues closed) and owes acceptance evidence, not construction; S18 is the largest job and declares S13 and S15 as dependencies, so it goes last against a settled tranche.

reestimate.S18: 11 open packages (3 P1: project_in_unauthorised_tranche, unpublished_declared_output, mandatory_artefacts; 8 P2: change-control, project-baseline, project-registers, wbs_absent, architecture-artifact, compliance-review, delivery-contract, phase-g)
